title: WebGPU SSAO in Rust: 32-Sample Ambient Occlusion with wgpu
description: Build screen-space ambient occlusion in WebGPU with Rust and wgpu: sample 32 spiral neighbors, blur a full-resolution AO mask, and tune it live with egui.
imageAlt: WebGPU SSAO demo showing animated Jax on a checkerboard floor under colored spotlights, with ambient occlusion controls open.
